derivation.method: Center-sample the listed CC0 source textures to a 16x16 logical grid, increase luminance contrast, map to Project Tarmin semantic palettes, force opposite logical edges to match, scale each logical pixel 2x nearest-neighbor, and copy a one-pixel edge gutter. Darkness is an original Project Tarmin aperture.

architectureOutputs.ironDoorTransform: Palette-remap and downsample the CC0 brick-door source into the existing 32x32 iron-door atlas region; semantic ID and atlas bounds are unchanged.
architectureOutputs.archwayTransform: Downsample to 64x64, remap to the Project Tarmin stone palette, and key the inner aperture transparent so the asset frames visible openings without revealing cells.
